newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.3 percent in the week ended November 16 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 3.8 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 0.2 percent from the prior month.
"Our index decreased because retailers' plans were for smaller sales gains last week versus the first week of the month," said a Schroder Wertheim & Co Inc report.
"The weakness that did exist was generally expected due to the shifting of calendars and promotional activity," said a Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd report.
